name: Avidich
description: Avidich was a planet located in the Avidich system in the Unknown Regions within the core territory of the Chiss Ascendancy. It was located on the Vagaari Corridor, a hyperlane that ran through the Unknown Regions. Avidich was a mountainous world with peaks that were considered impressive. The planet was used by the Chiss species to cultivate edible lichens.
